algorithm: Resolve the current OperatorAcceptanceRecord; Personal Layer selection is prohibited unless the exact norm is accepted in scope and the record hash matches.
Include every global norm and every active-layer norm assigned to the selected phase; task filters cannot remove them.
Add exact typed-map support matches for object types, action class, risk class, authority state, and debt codes.
Add explicitly requested norm IDs; explicit requests are additive only.
Add direct and transitive dependencies, required object schemas, gate contract, evidence rules, and repair routes.
If a mandatory norm, dependency, proof, schema, chain binding, or active-layer declaration is absent, return HOLD-RUNTIME-CAPSULE-INCOMPLETE.
determinism_rule: Canonical JSON of identical normalized input produces byte-identical selected norm IDs and record-key order.
